post.description: The body holds the buyer's corrections; leave it out when nothing changed.

get.description: The caller's newest quote, for the webshop chat panel (§9.6). Not an agent tool.
One of the caller's company's quotes, for the webshop chat panel (§9.6).

post.description:
The body holds the lines to add or change and the line ids to remove; the quote's
other lines stay. Returns a new quote with the complete line list.

Read a recipe photo into a new draft for the buyer to check and confirm. The photo
is never stored; the draft keeps the SHA-256 of the normalised image.

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo

422.description: No recipe found in the photo

503.description: Photo reading is not set up (no vision model)

post.description: The card's "Start over". A confirmed draft can't be discarded (409).
The card's "Edit as new draft": a new draft with the same content, to confirm.

get.description:
Totals since `EVENT_START`, then at most 200 cards that match the filters, grouped by
company, newest activity first. Live test runs (#98) are left out; `test_run` shows one
run's sessions instead.

schema.title: Response Get Steps Api V1 Public Orders  Session Id  Steps Get
Response Get Transcript Api V1 Public Orders  Session Id  Transcript Get

get.description: The session's full events; `?download=1` sends them as a file.

schema.title: Response Get Events Api V1 Public Orders  Session Id  Events Get

get.description: #41's chain check: one session's events, or the whole chain without `session_id`.

Server-sent events: `snapshot` (as `GET /orders`, with the same filters), then
`order_updated` (filtered), `step` and `transcript`, each with `id` = the
`status_events` id. One id can carry several events, so a reconnect with
`Last-Event-ID` first gets that id's whole group again, then the later events.

200.description: Server-sent events. Each `data:` is JSON: `snapshot` an `OverviewResponse`, `order_updated` an `OrderUpdated`, `step` a `StepEvent` and `transcript` a `TranscriptEvent`.

schema.title: Response 200 Stream Api V1 Public Stream Get

get.description:
Sections > groups > categories, in the shop's order. Only categories with at least
one product that has an image are listed.
The category's top 20 products with an image, best first. Unknown category: 404.

post.description:
Log this browser in as a user of the number's company, creating it if it's new.

The same browser typing the same number again stays the same user.

get.description:
This browser's session, or the dev caller when DEV_FAKE_CALLER is on, else 401.

A bearer token doesn't count here: REST reads only the cookie.

post.description:
Log in with email and password. 401 for a wrong email or password alike; 429 after
10 failed tries for the email within 10 minutes.

`phone_required` tells the login page to ask a hand-out account for its number.

delete.description: Log out: revoke this browser's session and clear the cookie. Safe to repeat.

post.description:
Open sign-up for the connectors: email, password (10 characters or more) and number.

Logs the browser in. The number's company is found or created as for a demo account.

Set the number of a hand-out account on its first login. Only while it has none: 409
after that.

get.description: This browser's messages, oldest first. Held messages appear when the call ends.

Server-sent events: `snapshot` (the inbox so far, as `GET /inbox`), then one
`inbox_message` per new message, with the message as JSON.
What the consent page shows. 404 when the request is unknown or expired.

post.description:
Allow issues a code for this user; Cancel sends `access_denied`. Either way the
browser goes to `redirect_to`, back to the client.

get.description: The page's view. Never uses the token up; stays readable as the receipt.

One buyer turn in the webshop chat. A new conversation starts when `conversation_id`
is null or unknown (for example after 30 idle minutes or a restart).

409.description: Busy: still answering the previous message

How this user's latest confirmation request went, for the `SentNotice` card: the
masked number, `delivery_status` as `request_confirmation` says it (`sent` or `failed`

"Ask for changes" on the confirmation page: the chat as the link's user, with

A2uiClientAction.title: A2uiClientAction
A2uiClientAction.description:
A card's button, as A2UI v0.9 sends it back: `{name, surfaceId, sourceComponentId,
timestamp, context}`.

AcknowledgeRequest.title: AcknowledgeRequest
AcknowledgeRequest.description:
`option_id` is the buyer's pick for a `choose` flag. An option that changes the
order makes a new quote, with the flag acknowledged on it.

AgentInfo.title: AgentInfo
AgentInfo.description: Assumed: the agent and prompt version that ran the session.

AskedLine.title: AskedLine
AskedLine.description: Echo of what the buyer asked for.

AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent
AuditEvent.description:
A full redacted event, as `/events` returns it. The payload shape depends on `type`.

`payload_hash` covers `{payload, text_fi, text_en}` exactly as stored (docs/audit-chain.md),
so the raw sentences are here too, null when the event has none; `text` turns a null into
an empty string for display. `payload` is null when it was deleted after the event.

BuildQuoteRequest.title: BuildQuoteRequest
BuildQuoteRequest.description:
The order's lines. With `recipe_draft_id`, a confirmed recipe draft's ingredients
are added as lines too, so `lines` may then be empty.

CardFlag.title: CardFlag
CardFlag.description: A flag on a card, for "2 flags: stock not confirmed, new product".

Channel.title: Channel
Channel.description: The channel a session came in through, one tile each on the overview.

ChatMenu.title: ChatMenu
ChatMenu.description: A menu that `show_menu` stored in the conversation, built from our recipe data.

ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest
ChatRequest.description: One buyer turn: a message or a card action, exactly one of them.

ChatSentLatest.title: ChatSentLatest
ChatSentLatest.description:
For the `SentNotice` card: how this user's latest confirmation request went, in the
words of `request_confirmation`'s answer. The page shows the SMS line only when
`delivery_status` is `sent`. The number is masked (`+358 40 *** **12`).

Claim.title: Claim
Claim.description:
Product claims, as the product data states them.

`lactose_free` means a lactose-free product only; a low-lactose product does not count.

Clarification.title: Clarification
Clarification.description: The single question back to the buyer. `options` may be empty for an open question.

ConfirmRecipeBody.title: ConfirmRecipeBody
ConfirmRecipeBody.description: The body of `POST /recipe-drafts/{draft_id}/confirm`: the request without the id.

ConnectRedirect.title: ConnectRedirect
ConnectRedirect.description: Where the browser goes next: the client's redirect URI with a code or an error.

ConnectRequestView.title: ConnectRequestView
ConnectRequestView.description:
`GET /api/v1/oauth/requests/{id}`: what the consent page shows.

"Allow <client_name> to order for <company_name>?" `redirect_host` is where the browser
goes next (the MCP spec asks the consent screen to show it).

DemoAccountRequest.title: DemoAccountRequest
DemoAccountRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/demo/accounts`: typing a phone number is the login.

`phone_e164` may be typed loosely ("040 123 4512"); the server normalises it, reading a
number without a country code as Finnish.

DemoAccountResponse.title: DemoAccountResponse
DemoAccountResponse.description: The browser's demo user. The session token travels only in the `simo_session` cookie.

DraftIngredient-Input.title: DraftIngredient
DraftIngredient-Input.description: One ingredient as read from the recipe. Amounts are per the recipe as written.

DraftIngredient-Output.title: DraftIngredient
DraftIngredient-Output.description: One ingredient as read from the recipe. Amounts are per the recipe as written.

Exclusion.title: Exclusion
Exclusion.description: Kitchen exclusions: the allergens and diets the kitchen rules out.

Flag.title: Flag
Flag.description: A notice on the quote. The buyer acknowledges it on the confirmation page.

InboxMessage.title: InboxMessage
InboxMessage.description: One message in the simulated phone (`InboxMessage` in `web/src/lib/demo/types.ts`).

KitchenType.title: KitchenType
KitchenType.description: The kind of kitchen a demo company is, chosen from its phone number (#32, #61).

LineRequest.title: LineRequest
LineRequest.description: One structured line from the agent. The engine never sees raw speech.

Localized.title: Localized
Localized.description: The same text in Finnish and English.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/session`: email and password log the browser in.

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description:
The session travels in the `simo_session` cookie.

`phone_required` is true for a hand-out account that has no number yet: the login
page then asks for it (`POST /api/v1/me/phone`) before going on.

Me.title: Me
Me.description: `GET /api/v1/me`: the signed-in user's company and kitchen profile.

NotOrdered.title: NotOrdered
NotOrdered.description: A recipe ingredient without a product link. The recipe data is Finnish only.

OrderUpdated.title: OrderUpdated
OrderUpdated.description: The full card with its company, so a new card can be placed, and the fresh totals.

PhoneRequest.title: PhoneRequest
PhoneRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/me/phone`: the number of a hand-out account, set once.

ProposeRecipeRequest.title: ProposeRecipeRequest
ProposeRecipeRequest.description: A recipe the buyer showed, as read. Stored as a draft for the buyer to confirm.

QuoteChange.title: QuoteChange
QuoteChange.description: What changed compared with the previous quote, after an edit or a requote.

QuoteResponse.title: QuoteResponse
QuoteResponse.description: The engine's decision plus the quote id, version, status, expiry and hash.

QuoteStatus.title: QuoteStatus
QuoteStatus.description:
Quote lifecycle.

A quote starts as `ready`, `needs_clarification` or `rejected`, after the engine's
decision. Only a `ready` quote can be sent for confirmation; the other two are
answered or changed with `update_quote`.

RankedCandidate.title: RankedCandidate
RankedCandidate.description: One candidate that passed every check, in ranking order (`rank` 1 is the best).

RecipeDraft.title: RecipeDraft
RecipeDraft.description:
A recipe draft as stored. `ingredients` are as edited, not scaled; `scaled` has the
amounts for `portions`, which is what will be ordered.

RecipeRef.title: RecipeRef
RecipeRef.description:
A line from a recipe (#34). Without `ingredient_index` the line is the whole recipe:
the quote service turns it into one line per ingredient with a product link and lists
the other ingredients in `not_ordered`.

RequestedUnit.title: RequestedUnit
RequestedUnit.description: The unit the buyer asked in. With `package`, the word is in `package_word`.

ShopCatalogue.title: ShopCatalogue
ShopCatalogue.description: Every section that has at least one product to show, in the shop's order.

ShopCategory.title: ShopCategory
ShopCategory.description: A leaf category: one of the product file's categories.

ShopGroup.title: ShopGroup
ShopGroup.description: The second level of the shop tree, for example Fresh products > Cheese.

ShopProducts.title: ShopProducts
ShopProducts.description: A leaf category's top products, best first (#118).

ShopSection.title: ShopSection
ShopSection.description: The top level of the shop tree, for example Fresh products.

SignupRequest.title: SignupRequest
SignupRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/signup`: open sign-up for the connectors. Nothing is verified.

The email is lower-cased; the password needs at least 10 characters; `phone_e164` is
read like the demo account's.

StateGroup.title: StateGroup
StateGroup.description: The groups behind the counters and the `?state=` filter (#49, "States and totals").

Step.title: Step
Step.description:
One audit event without its payload, enough to verify the chain (§8.5).

The hash covers `session_id` and `quote_id` too (docs/audit-chain.md), so they are here.

SummaryLine.title: SummaryLine
SummaryLine.description: The fields of `QuoteLine` the summary shows, with the richer trace.

SummaryRequest.title: SummaryRequest
SummaryRequest.description: Assumed grouping: one request ("what was asked") with the lines added for it.

SummaryTrace.title: SummaryTrace
SummaryTrace.description: `Trace` plus the ranked candidates #49 lists for the summary.

SummaryTraceRemoval.title: SummaryTraceRemoval
SummaryTraceRemoval.description: `TraceRemoval` plus the products the filter removed.

Totals.title: Totals
Totals.description: Counts since `EVENT_START`, not limited by the filters or the 200-card cap.

Trace.title: Trace
Trace.description:
Candidates found, removed per reason and left.

Each candidate is counted once, at the first check it fails, in the order the checks run.

UpdateQuoteBody.title: UpdateQuoteBody
UpdateQuoteBody.description:
The changes to a quote (#101): `lines` are new lines and changed ones, matched by
`line_id`; a line of the quote that is not sent stays as it was. `remove_line_ids`
takes lines out.

Answering a clarification is sending that line again with the chosen `product_id`.

VerifyResult.title: VerifyResult
VerifyResult.description: From #41's verify function; the global chain without `session_id`.

ViewFlag.title: ViewFlag
ViewFlag.description: A contract flag plus what the confirmation adds to it.
